label: Entailment
quotes: At the request of Disclosing Party, Recipient shall return to Disclosing Party all Confidential Information of Disclosing Party (including any copies thereof) or certify the destruction thereof.
reason: The agreement obligates the Recipient to return or certify destruction of Confidential Information on the Disclosing Party's request, which under the usual convention supports a return/destroy obligation even without an explicit termination trigger.
